entities.name: PMID:25087997
observations: Male Sprague-Dawley rats received oral timosaponin A3, 100 mg/kg/day for 14 days; serum total bile acids increased and bile bile-acid components decreased.

In sandwich-cultured rat hepatocytes, timosaponin A3 increased ROS and HO-1, reduced ATP and mitochondrial membrane potential, decreased Ntcp, Bsep and Mrp2 expression, and lowered taurocholate accumulation and biliary excretion; N-acetylcysteine ameliorated effects.

entities.name: Timosaponin A3
observations: Steroidal saponin from Anemarrhena asphodeloides; PMID 25087997 reports rat hepatotoxicity investigations.

entities.name: TA3 rat hepatotoxicity mechanism
observations: Rat oral dosing (100 mg/kg/day, 14 days) altered serum and biliary bile acids; cultured rat hepatocytes showed ROS elevation, oxidative/mitochondrial stress, and downregulated Ntcp, Bsep and Mrp2 with impaired taurocholate handling. This supports the proposed pathway but transporter/ROS mechanistic assays were in vitro.
